findings.reason: this plan's own §6/§8/§10 exist precisely because a forked second copy of a shared mechanism (interpreter probe, SLURM resolution, DataAccess writer) was found and folded back onto its owner; naming imas_codex/ingestion/graph.py in §19 keeps that from repeating and costs the author one line.
findings.text: §19's relink of the 201 existing jt-60sa chunks says "a link pass that the pipeline owns" without naming the existing owner; imas_codex/ingestion/graph.py already holds the chunk-link passes (link_chunks_to_imas_paths:64, link_chunks_to_data_nodes:151) that ingest_files calls at pipeline.py:535 and :566, so the relink belongs as a new pass there, reached from the same ingest path, not as a fresh helper

rubric_items.deep_module: pass — the plan's new behaviour is hidden behind single-entry interfaces rather than spread thin: §6 resolve_remote_environment() is one resolver that hid the whole per-facility interpreter/module contract behind a facility block and pass-down; §17 pending_embed_predicate(alias) renders the pending/retry predicate once at a single call site.
rubric_items.duplicate_owner: a finding — §19 proposes "a link pass that the pipeline owns" to relink the 201 orphan chunks but does not name the module that already owns chunk-link passes (imas_codex/ingestion/graph.py: link_chunks_to_imas_paths, link_chunks_to_data_nodes), so a new relink helper is the path of least resistance.
rubric_items.interface_budget: pass — public_definitions 0, cli_options 0, mcp_views 0, refusal_families 0; the two implementable sections add nothing to any family — §19 states "Interface budget: nothing added" and §14 uses the existing `discover paths --root` and `discover code --path-prefix` options, and the landed sections net-retire surface (five DDL statements removed in §15, setup_commands retired in §6, the over-fetch and post-filters retired in §16/§18, an orphaned adjudication row removed in §17).
rubric_items.reuse_search: pass — every implementable section cites the mechanism it reuses by name and opens it: §19 names ingest_files and the step-6 HAS_CHUNK MERGE in imas_codex/ingestion/pipeline.py:522 and reads the CodeFile-HAS_EXAMPLE-CodeExample-HAS_CHUNK shape; §14 uses the existing `discover paths --root` seeding and `discover code --path-prefix` claim scope; the landed sections' review comments record reuse substitutions (the WikiChunk DOCUMENTS edge instead of a new DOCUMENTED_IN edge, GraphClient.ensure_vector_indexes, remote.locations._service_url_for_slurm).
rubric_items.thin_wrapper: pass — no implementable section adds a layer over machinery it could extend: §19 explicitly repairs the existing writer ("never a hand-written MERGE", "the same code path"); §6 retired data_access_patterns.setup_commands rather than layering a parallel block; §15 replaced five hand-written CREATE VECTOR INDEX statements with the owner instead of wrapping them.
